deviations: resolveSessionManagerConfig takes (globalConfig, localConfig?) whole config objects instead of only (merged); a single merged config still works, so the design's call shape is a subset.
Added parseLoopInterval export (validator and config) so expected-fleet/launch can derive cadence from the same parser.

reserveGb accepts 0 (other capacity numbers must be > 0); stall.maxAttempts must be a positive integer (AC only forbade negatives; 0 attempts is meaningless). noOutputMinutes/requestionHours reject negatives only, per AC.
Validator also requires sessionManager.name (workers address the manager by it) and checks optional trustedAuthorIds (design 10.6) as a string array.
